summary: @or-sdk/ccp preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The npm package @or-sdk/ccp@10.15.6 declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. The setup.mjs script is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers and per-function inline string-lookup objects that hide plain strings such as 'musl', '/etc/os-release', 'Alpine', and '--version'. It downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling 727KB file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` carries a `@bun @bun-cjs` header followed by a heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array-shuffle `push(shift())` transform, opaque decoder tables, thousands of numeric constants) with no readable relationship to the package's stated CCP SDK purpose. Pulling a second-language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at install time is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern: it bypasses Node-only static analysis and hides the payload behind two obfuscation layers plus a runtime switch. The behavior fires on every default install of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
